plan: My value is $25. In a single-round auction, my goal is to maximize potential profit. Since values are drawn independently and randomly, I'll use a strategic bid slightly below my true value. Bidding exactly at $25 risks losing money if others bid higher. A bid around $20-$22 gives me a buffer for potential profit while still having a good chance of winning. This approach minimizes downside risk while preserving upside potential.
